01

A report before the first cited verse

A report transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

01
Report from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
“The falaq is the morning.”
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" الْفَلَقُ: الصُّبْحُ "

02

“and from the evil of darkness when it settles”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 113:3).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and from the evil of darkness when it settles [al-Falaq: 3], he said: “The ghasiq is the night; ‘when it settles’ (idha waqab) means when it enters, that is, at sunset.”
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ [الفلق: 3] قَالَ: " الْغَاسِقُ: هُوَ اللَّيْلُ، إِذَا وَقَبَ: يَعْنِي إِذَا دَخَلَ يَعْنِي غُرُوبَ الشَّمْسِ "
